manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Stores facts, preferences, insights, and tasks to persistent memory.
manifest.name: @kody-w/manage_memory_agent

content.description: The content to store in memory. This should be a concise statement that captures the important information.

importance.description: Importance rating from 1-5, where 5 is most important.

memory_type.description: Type of memory to store. Can be 'fact', 'preference', 'insight', or 'task'.

tags.description: Optional list of tags to categorize this memory.

user_guid.description: Optional unique identifier of the user to store memory in a user-specific location.
